detailed_descriptions_html.en:
Take a deep breath. And the first crate.

Military Base Tidy Up is a calm game about putting things in order. No timers, no enemies, no pressure – just you, a huge bunker full of gear and that pleasant feeling when another shelf is neatly filled.

Simple and satisfying

  • Grab armfuls – click after click, the stack in your hands keeps growing.

  • Put it all away in one go – hold the button at a shelf and watch everything fly into place, one item after another.

  • Arrange it your way – a free shelf takes the kind of the first item you put on it. You plan, the rack looks better and better.

  • Watch the mess disappear – counters on the sector boards tick down, and a full rack celebrates with a flash and a sound.

Always something to discover

Behind every door there's a new sector – from the canteen to the command center – and new notes left by the old crew. Every item you put away raises your level, and in the Terminal you unlock upgrades, carts and helper drones that take over part of the work.

With friends or in peace and quiet

Play solo at your own pace or invite up to three people to online co-op. Save anytime – pick up exactly where you left off.

Features

  • 50,000 items to put in order

  • 12 sectors to unlock one by one

  • Upgrade tree, shop, carts and drones

  • Solo or online co-op for up to 4 players

  • Xbox and PlayStation controller support
